finding.detail: The current dataset admission gate fully bound admitted outcome receipts only when credit_label was non-UNKNOWN. For UNKNOWN-credit rows, registry membership alone allowed an admitted receipt from another causal episode to be attached as false provenance.

repair.mechanism: If outcome_receipt_sha256 is present, verify exact admitted receipt binding to training trace, transition trace, generation, Entry event/admission, route decision, GRID10 plan, cell, role and credit label regardless of whether credit is UNKNOWN or non-UNKNOWN.
repair.unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; the change binds provenance and does not convert unknown outcome into reward or truth.

regression.negative_case: UNKNOWN row plus admitted receipt from another Entry event must fail OUTCOME_CAUSAL_BINDING_MISMATCH:entry_event_sha256
regression.positive_case: UNKNOWN row plus exactly bound VERIFIED UNKNOWN receipt remains admissible

next_exact_gate: Run the retained FREE isolated full-spine Vercel Sandbox executor against exact current main plus exact current PR1263 head and observe this dataset-admission regression executing. Bind source/tree identity, Sandbox execution result and credential nonpersistence before any runtime promotion.
